name: Data-centre fibre
simple: Short glass cables between the boxes in one building, all belonging to the same company.
technical: Inside the fabric: 100–400G Ethernet over short single-mode fibre (or copper for the last metres to a server).

2010.technical: Inside the data centre in 2010: 10 Gigabit Ethernet over short multimode fibre (10GBASE-SR, 850 nm) between the switches; the servers hang off them on copper.
